The trip is a metered RydeTAXI journey (total $39.86, distance $26.93 over 19.10 km [F7]), so extra kilometres pass straight into the fare and the RD-2 metered branch applies, not the fixed-quote branch [F7][RD-2]. The RD-4 screen fails: the only incident on record is an Accident on the Ayer Rajah Expressway reported 22:07, after segment F3 started at 21:57 and after it ended at 22:04, so no qualifying incident was reported before the deviated segment [F12][F3][RD-4]. Nor is there any rider-requested stop — nothing shows the rider named a place the car stopped at [F8][F3][RD-3]. Segment F3 is therefore an unexempted off-route segment [F3][RD-1][RD-5].
